exposure: in vitro fertilization with embryo transfer after regret of sterilization
hydrosalpinx closure before in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection with embryo transfer
cohort: 50 women with Essure micro-inserts in situ who became pregnant
finding: The presence of intratubal micro-inserts is unlikely to interfere with implantation and the developing amniotic sac and fetus.
mod_finding: Seven infants were delivered via cesarean section.
